text: in the cart/editor in the color tool it doesnt have any way for me to type a hex in anywhere i just realized lol rip ;_;
resolution: Added direct hex editing to both Color Studio contexts: Library CURRENT updates the shared OKLCH color live, while Material Palette ACTIVE SLOT commits one undoable slot override on Enter or blur. Extracted the existing canonical paint hex behavior into a reusable validated HexColorInput, preserved ColorField behavior, and added shorthand/full-hex plus exact OKLCH round-trip coverage. Verified 23/23 paint tests and a ReleaseFast editor ship build.
